Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that “Abraham married Hagar (also called Keturah),” conflating Keturah with Hagar. The cited scriptures (Genesis 25:1 and 1 Chronicles 1:32) identify Keturah as the woman Abraham married after Sarah’s death; they do not equate her with Hagar. This misidentification led to the wrong final answer.
